theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have A {x y u v : List CoreIdent} (h1 : x.Subset u) (h2 : y.Subset v) :
      (x ++ y).Subset (u ++ v) :=
    List.Subset.app (List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ h1)
      (List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ h2)
  intro h
  simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars]
  induction h
  case app =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split <;> simp [extractOldExprVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, A]
    · simp [List.Subset]
    · exact List.nil_subset _
    · refine A ?_ ?_ <;> assumption
  any_goals simp_all only [extractOldExprVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, A,
    List.Subset.empty]
